# CampusVerify

> A credit-powered survey platform connecting researchers with verified university students and the general public for honest, campus-scoped responses.

CampusVerify helps students and general users run surveys with verified respondents. Students sign up with an academic email and get campus-scoped feeds; general users run public surveys. Credits are earned by answering and spent to publish.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of CampusVerify, how it works, FAQ, and sign-up.
- [Log in](/auth): Sign in to your Student or General account.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a Student or General account.
- [Forgot password](/forgot-password): Request a password reset email.
